storyCards.headline: Die Another Day: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Madonna's "Die Another Day" reached #8 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #8 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Die Another Day was released in 2006.

Album: I'm Going To Tell You A Secret (Soundtrack) (2006).
